DEEPAK KUMAR JHA

SUMMARY

Manager & Fund controller with 13+ years with leading 12 professionals

of experience supporting global Private Equity, Hedge fund ,Mutual fund , FOF and Infrastructure strategies within large, multi-asset investment

platforms.

Worked on Products like Mutual Funds, Elf's, Debt ,Equity Bond, ,Fixed Income, Derivatives etc. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel skills: Formulae, functions, charts, different SWIFT Msg. Experience in using third party

financial databases like Bloomberg, Interactive Data Corporation,

Reuters, other sites like Blomberg, TCS Bancs, CCH/FCAT, IM Actions Etc. Strong domain experience in Mandatory, Voluntary & Income Corporate

Actions on domestic and international markets. Events like splits,

dividends, spin-offs, rights Issue,

mergers and acquisitions, tender offer, Subscription offer, exchange offer,

consent, Dutch Auction, Cash Dividends, Drips, Drop's, Partial call, Full

call etc. Proven expertise in fund-level operations, NAV governance, investor

capital mechanics, and valuation controls under USGAAP (ASC 946 & 820, 205, 210, 220, 230) & IFRS (Standards 2, 9, 13, 10, 7,15, 16,18, & IAS 16, 40,

36, 23, 37,38) Trusted partner to Investment, Treasury, Legal, Tax, and IR

teams, complex fund structures.

SKILLS

People Management

Private Equity Fund

Asset Management

Hedge fund

Mutual fund

Nav Calculation

Fund Accounting

Corporate Action

Alteryx ,Exceptor

Portfolio Valuation

Trade processing and

Cash and Position

settlement Security Pricing.

Reconciliation

Process Transaction

Onboarding to new client

EXPERIENCE

July 2024 - April 2026 Manager, Genpact India Pvt Ltd, Banglore

Managed a team of 12 + professionals, overseeing client accounts and

ensuring all corporate action event.

Event scrubbing and publishing it our clients for all corporate action

events Setting up the announcement in Custodian transact processing

system for timely payment.

Tracking the instructions received and processing the entitlements

accordingly.

Reviewing the unmatched/stuck trade instructions received from our

clients and fixing it up to release them in the market for smooth

settlement Tracking and reporting of fails trades to our clients.

Posted correctly in accounting data base. Rich experience in preparing

reconciliations tracking with custody, cash reconciliation, Position

reconciliation all the type of corporate action event.

Review Corporate Action, Pricing, Data Quality Check, Trade Capturing

and Investors activity done by different teams.

Understanding of corporate actions exceptions and logic.

As Manager my Responsibility to Update the MIS (Management Information system) for Upper Management.

Keeping strong relation between clients and agent/issuers by

contacting directly.

Managing Day to day operation related corporate actions/Income

Process.

Handling all escalations from client side as well as from upstream

&Downstream team.

Managing all the recon breaks aged/new, suggesting proper way to

clean up.

Preparing KPI and KRI, SOD/MOD/EOD reports, sending to Onshore

counterpart.

Managing staffing, alignment of employees, attrition and selection

process.

Helping the entire team on any CA critical events, arranging cross

training as per need.

Providing automation ideas and implementing with the help of

automation team.

Key Accomplishment under Genpact- Automated the entire DTCC platform after which the All-CA events automatically flowing to

internal Applications and getting posted which is saving immense time and avoiding errors and misses.

April 2020 - July 2024 Team Leader, JP MORGAN and Chase, Banglore

Directing end-to-end fund operations and accounting oversight for Private Equity, Private Credit, Real Estate, Infrastructure, FOF and supporting multi-jurisdictional investment strategies.

Oversee NAV governance, close processes, and valuation support,

ensuring alignment with fund documentation and internal valuation

policies.

Act as financial controller to review and approve financial statements

under USGAAP (ASC 946 & 820) & IFRS 2, 9, 13. 7,15, 16,18, & IAS 16, 40, 36, 23, 37, 38,including schedules of investments and partners' capital

statements.

Govern capital calls, distributions, equalization, and financial

statement reporting across complex fund structures.

Oversee American and European waterfall models, including carried

interest,incentive allocations.

Provide technical leadership on credit and valuation matters,

including amortization, impairment, and expected credit loss (ECL) analysis. Execute and oversee principal loan activities such as draw

downs, pay downs, rate resets, and contract rollovers, ensuring

accurate system booking and downstream reporting.

Partner closely with Credit Finance, Accounting, and Treasury teams to ensure timely and accurate NAV finalization, adherence to accounting

policies, and strong operational controls.

Carried interest, performance fees, management fees, and incentive

fee calculations were reviewed and validated.

Fund-level reconciliations including expenses, accruals, income, and cash were prepared and monitored. Oversaw capital call, distribution,

equalization, and investor allocation calculations to ensure accuracy

and timely execution .New hedge funds were successfully launched,

and operational readiness was ensured through structured training and process transition.

Compliance with SLAs, internal controls, and operational risk

frameworks was monitored and maintained.

Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) were developed and updated

to align with process enhancements and regulatory change.

Management dashboards, MIS reports, and senior leadership

summaries were prepared to support decision-making.

Collaboration with IT and project management teams was executed to

implement system enhancements and automation initiatives.

Performance management, team training, and career development

activities were conducted to strengthen operational capability.

Led internal and external audit engagements, coordinating

documentation, walk throughs, and control evidence to ensure timely

closure of audit observations.

Process improvement initiatives were supported to enhance efficiency,

mitigate risk, and improve service quality.

October 2015 - March 2020 Process Associate, Societe General Global Solution Center, Banglore

Calculated NAV for the Mutual fund Private Equity fund, hedge fund

and fund of funds.

Traded processed, cash and portfolio reconciled, security priced, and

corporate actions resolved to compute correct NAV valuation for

clients.

Demonstrated broad competence in computing NAV, preparing

valuations, and performing monthly and yearly audit reports for

Mutual Funds.

Ensured settlement of daily trades, forward and spot payments of

dividend and interest, and updated securities prices for clients

(utilizing Bloomberg and structured products.

Analyzed cash, derivative, mutual, and institutional funds, and

performed NAV calculation, custody, and fund manager reconciliation processes.

Reviewed corporate actions, pricing, data quality checks, trade

capturing, and investor activity conducted by different teams.

Reviewed all security prices.

Reviewed daily cash and position reconciliations.

Get Bloomberg support for price, Corporate Actions, FX difference etc.

Make sure all trades/Prices and rates are correct, fill Fund's Checklist.

Keeping strong relation between clients and agent/issuers by

contacting directly.

January 2012 - September 2015 Financial Analyst, RR Donnelley & Sons, Chennai

Preparing monthly and quarterly financial reports analyzing and

planning.

In depth analysis on variances and comparing reports actual vs budget

(Balance Sheet Income statement and cash flow and comparison to

previous reporting periods.

Assist in data analysis, data validation, reviews of standard reports and

analyze actual.

Actual vs. budget, dashboard analysis and instant analysis like (ad-

hock analysis).

Prepare financial budgets and perform Cash Flow analysis. Which

includes profitability and financial statements.

Coordinating, planning, and executing the financial reporting

components for the external audit.

Preparing financial reports and interacting with clients, developing

and maintaining.
